# [CS063] Deprecated Dependency (dependency-deprecated)

The module is marked deprecated by its authors.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Supply Chain & Provenance |
| **CWE** | [CWE-1104](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1104.html) |
| **OWASP** | A03:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

A // Deprecated: comment on the module directive means the authors no longer maintain it, so future vulnerabilities will not be fixed. The notice usually names the replacement.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```text
require github.com/golang/protobuf v1.5.4 // Deprecated: use google.golang.org/protobuf
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```text
require google.golang.org/protobuf v1.36.0
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [dependency-deprecated]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    dependency-deprecated: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore dependency-deprecated -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** dependency-deprecated
```
